messages:
Nora (People Ops): Heads-up: new manager Grace Lim starts Mon. I made a short 'manager sprint essentials' checklist for preboard -> end of week1 (tech + ops + goals). Please review and add missing items. TL;DR below.
Grace Lim: Thanks! Quick q: laptop day0 pickup or ship? who adds me to GitHub org and Slack groups? also would love an infra buddy for first week.
Ibrahim (IT): If procurement form is in by Thu we can ship overnight for Day0. I handle Okta + Google invites and will send GitHub org invite once manager approval shows in the request. If you already have a corporate device reply here and we won't ship.
Ibrahim (IT): Proc ticket snippet to paste:
"Title: New manager device + access - Grace Lim
Start: 2026-10-05
Team: Eng - Platform
Device: Macbook Pro 14 / Existing device: None
Needed: Okta, GSuite, GitHub org (write), AWS staging read, Vault read, SSH pubkey registration
Manager approver: Evan"
Evan (Infra): I can buddy week1 for infra walkthroughs. Day2 demo: staging cluster, deploy flow, where batching/caching live. For demo pools: file request in #eng-infra with purpose, region, expected concurrency, retention hours and I can fast-track small pools.
Mika (Finance): For expense card: manager signoff + headcount code required. Virtual card generally same-week after approvals; physical card 5-7 business days. Email finance@redwood.com with the headcount code.
Nora (People Ops): Sprint essentials (compact):
- Preboard (3 days out): procurement ticket + headcount code to Finance, Okta invite sent, calendar seats created for intros.
- Day0 (eve): confirm device tracking # or pickup, ensure calendar has Manager 1:1 and team intro slots.
- Day1: 30m 1:1 + access check (Okta/GitHub/AWS), security intro, enroll MFA, confirm SSH key added.
- Day2: infra buddy walkthrough + staging demo, request demo pool if needed.
- Day3: meet direct reports 1:1s, pair on small triage or PR, shadow deploy.
- Day4: draft 30/60/90 (lean - 3 outcomes each) and ask for manager feedback.
- Day5: kickoff first ownership task + week1 retro, confirm any remaining access (KMS/Vault).
Nora (People Ops): 30/60/90 sample (one-line style): 30d - ramp & merge small PRs; 60d - own a customer-facing patch or minor feature; 90d - deliver a measurable perf or reliability improvement. Keep metrics and owners.
onboard-bot: Calendar event created: "Manager Sprint - Day 0" invited: grace.lim@redwood.com.
Grace Lim: MFA done, I put my SSH pubkey in the ticket. I'll draft my 30/60/90 and drop it here by Friday. Thanks for the buddy offer Evan!
Ibrahim (IT): GitHub invite sent. If you don't see it check spam and Okta status. For prod/KMS access we'll need written justification & Evan's approval.
Evan (Infra): For demo pool fast path: requests before 3pm PT often same-day for small pools (<8h). Include expected qps and retention.
Mika (Finance): Grace - DM me headcount code and expected monthly spend and I'll start the virtual card flow.
Nora (People Ops): Perfect. I'll follow up with Procurement & IT to confirm laptop ETA and close the checklist when all items are green. Welcome Grace! :tada:
